written.myAnswer: Interdisciplinary fields combine knowledge and methods from different disciplines. Examples include nanotechnology (physics, chemistry, materials science and engineering), artificial intelligence (computer science, mathematical logic and neuroscience), and climate change research.

Complex problems often cannot be solved adequately using the knowledge of a single discipline. Collaboration combines relevant expertise, perspectives and methods, helping researchers develop better solutions, gain a fuller understanding and generate new ideas. Climate change is one example of an issue requiring knowledge from several fields.

Interdisciplinary fields of physics combine physics with other disciplines to study or solve problems. Examples include nanotechnology (physics, chemistry, materials science and engineering), artificial intelligence (computer science, mathematical logic and neuroscience), and climate change research, which draws on several sciences.
